results.label: the practice surface answers with the saved options and an idle timer
an empty day is unrecorded and is not a failure
no length, ambience or intention is preselected on an idle timer
the payload claims no state, no effect and no authority
starting without a saved preset or h/m/s is refused
a money target is refused as a practice intention too, and nothing is written
no caller clock, owner, account or elapsed time is accepted
a stale revision is a conflict, not a write
a saved preset starts a running timer at zero on the server’s clock
the chosen ambience is recorded as the trader’s declaration and never as playback
the optional intention is kept unverified, not labelled process-oriented
a second start is refused while a session is open
the running time is measured by the server, not reported by the caller
bell markers are elapsed-time marks inside the measured time
pause keeps the measured running time and counts one pause
a paused gap is not counted as practice
resume restarts the running clock without losing the earlier running time
completing writes one receipt with the server-measured running time
the receipt carries the chosen length, the declaration and the note
reaching the chosen length is a fact, and no effect is claimed about it
the day totals are the recorded sessions and their measured seconds
nothing is carried over once the session is complete
history is readonly and keeps the recorded receipt
progress counts records, never results
progress has no target, no score and says so
progress is bounded and ordered
a custom h/m/s length is accepted and labelled custom
completing early is recorded as it happened, with no failure label
the second record of the day is a second version, both retained
cancel writes no session at all
completing or cancelling with nothing open is refused
a timer open for more than 24 hours cannot be completed as one session
cancelling that abandoned timer writes nothing and claims nothing
a day that has not happened is refused at the day surface
a malformed day is refused at the day surface
another trader sees an unrecorded day, never these records
another trader starting a session does not touch this trader’s records
the briefing carries the practice day view with no authority
the journal day carries that day’s practice records only
another day shows nothing recorded, never today’s sessions
practice state never appears in a trade refusal: it is not a gate
the backup carries the practice records
a restored archive is accepted as an archive
a restored archive never becomes this trader’s recorded session
progress counts the archive separately and never merges it in
two receipts and one archive are stored under this trader
a recorded session cannot be edited in place
a recorded session cannot be re-dated
deleting the trader removes their practice records with them

scope: M108 practice API and server-measured timer: actual runtime/auth/SQL/DOM, fixedUTC and tiny raster/literal journals; not real chart/provider/broker/pixel/production or mental-state proof
